units.source_text: 我沒害死女人，也沒勒索女人的錢財——

en.t: I had not killed the woman, nor had I extorted money from her--

units.source_text: 儘管我心中的一隅微弱地發出這樣的抗議聲，但冷靜地重新一想，又犯了以往的老毛病，認為確實是我的錯。

en.t: Although a faint voice of protest like that rose weakly in one corner of my heart, when I calmly thought it over again I fell back into my old habit and concluded that it really was my fault.

units.source_text: 我怎麼都無法與人面對面爭論。

en.t: I simply could never argue with people face to face.

units.source_text: 我極力地剋制著，燒酒陰鬱的醉意使我變得更加險惡，

en.t: I did my utmost to restrain myself, while the gloomy drunkenness from the shochu made me grow still more dangerous,

units.source_text: 我自言自語般地說道：「不過，唯獨被關進牢房這件事不算是罪。

en.t: I said, as if talking to myself, "Still, being locked in a cell itself does not count as a sin.

units.source_text: 我覺得只要弄懂了罪的反詞，就能把握罪的本質。

en.t: I feel that if I can understand the antonym of sin, I can grasp the essence of sin.

units.source_text: ……神……救贖……愛……光明……可是，神有撒旦這個反詞，

en.t: ... God... salvation... love... light... But God has Satan as its antonym,

units.source_text: 而救贖的反詞應該是苦惱吧，愛的反詞是恨，光明的反詞是黑暗，善的反詞是惡。

en.t: and the antonym of salvation must be anguish; the antonym of love is hatred, of light is darkness, and of good is evil.
